paid_market_gaps.gap: GitHub's built-in dependency-graph SBOM export is SPDX only; CycloneDX needs separate tooling
GitLab CycloneDX dependency-list export is locked to the Ultimate tier and project-level only
Dependency-Track treats SBOM and VEX as separate uploads; no atomic SBOM-plus-VEX ingestion
Tools lag new CycloneDX versions: Trivy rejected 1.7 SBOMs for months; AWS Inspector exports only 1.4

wtp_evidence: Buyers pay for hosted SBOM ingestion and monitoring (Dependency-Track SaaS $250-$500/month), but CycloneDX generation itself is free: Syft (Apache-2.0) outputs CycloneDX and cdxgen (Apache-2.0) generates CycloneDX 1.6/1.7 and downgrades to 1.4/1.5.
bundling_note: CycloneDX output is free in open-source generators and bundled in GitLab, Docker, AWS Inspector and SCA platforms, so format support alone is a feature, not a product.
summary: No standalone opening: CycloneDX format/version support is a commodity feature of free OSS and bundled platforms. Small wedge: cheap hosted SBOM+VEX ingestion and version conversion for teams outside GitHub Enterprise/GitLab Ultimate, overlapping crowded SBOM-management vendors.
